Meta's Muse AI Assistant Gains Popularity, Faces Trust Concerns

Meta's AI assistant, Muse, has rapidly climbed to the top of the App Store charts. The AI tool is designed to function as a personal assistant, capable of processing user files and emails to provide assistance. Despite its popularity, the AI agent is also facing scrutiny regarding trust issues.
